terminal_record.title: TrumpFile and Noel Casler Allege 1997 Miss Teen USA Rehearsal Conduct
terminal_record.description_short: TrumpFile and Noel Casler separately allege rehearsal conduct at the 1997 Miss Teen USA pageant; the incident remains unverified and their accounts conflict on Ivanka Trump’s age.
terminal_record.description_medium: TrumpFile.org dates its Miss Teen USA entry to August 20, 1997 and alleges that Donald Trump asked co-host Ivanka Trump for a lap dance during rehearsal. Noel Casler posted a similar allegation in 2020, but his post says Ivanka was 16 while TrumpFile says she was 15; a 2016 SFGATE report also described her as 16. These sources document attributed claims, not independent confirmation of the alleged conduct or its precise date.
terminal_record.description_long: TrumpFile.org dates its Miss Teen USA timeline entry to August 20, 1997 and alleges that Donald Trump asked his daughter Ivanka, a co-host, for a lap dance during rehearsal. In a public post on January 21, 2020, former entertainment staffer Noel Casler made a similar allegation, writing that Trump called Ivanka over during a rehearsal and that she gave him a lap dance in view of the crew. These statements remain allegations; the retrieved materials do not independently establish that the conduct occurred. The sources also conflict on Ivanka’s age. TrumpFile says she was 15, while Casler’s post says 16 and a 2016 SFGATE report describes her as 16 at the pageant. The exact rehearsal date is not identified, and the pageant timeline’s date should not be treated as a verified date for the alleged incident. TrumpFile also groups this claim with accounts about contestants’ dressing rooms, but the supplied evidence does not establish that those accounts describe the same incident. Keep the allegations attributed and the age and chronology unresolved unless stronger contemporaneous or independent evidence becomes available.
terminal_record.date_precision: TrumpFile timeline date; exact rehearsal date is not established.

source_fact_map.fact: TrumpFile.org displays an August 20, 1997 entry date and alleges that Trump asked Ivanka for a lap dance during rehearsals. This documents what the page claims, not independent proof of the conduct.
source_fact_map.quote: During rehearsals the day of or in the days before, Donald Trump asked her for a lap dance in front of the crew.
source_fact_map.source_excerpt: TrumpFile.org page, “Miss Teen USA: Donald gets lap dance from Ivanka, watches girls undress,” displays the timeline date August 20, 1997 and states: “During rehearsals the day of or in the days before, Donald Trump asked her for a lap dance in front of the crew.” The page says Ivanka was 15 and was last updated August 21, 2025.

source_fact_map.fact: Noel Casler’s January 21, 2020 post makes an allegation about a Miss Teen USA rehearsal and says Ivanka was 16. The post is an allegation, not independent corroboration.
source_fact_map.quote: On ‘Miss Teen USA’ a 16 year-old Ivanka was hosting, in the middle of a rehearsal Trump called her over and had her sit on his lap.
source_fact_map.source_excerpt: Post by NoelCaslerComedy @caslernoel, posted 2020-01-21T19:15:56Z: “On ‘Miss Teen USA’ a 16 year-old Ivanka was hosting, in the middle of a rehearsal Trump called her over and had her sit on his lap. She gave him a lap dance in full view of a disgusted crew, Trump leered back at us as if to say ‘what are u gonna do about it!?’ @realDonaldTrump”

source_fact_map.fact: A 2016 SFGATE report says Ivanka was 16 and co-hosted the pageant, conflicting with the age stated by TrumpFile. It does not report the alleged lap dance.
source_fact_map.quote: Ivanka Trump, the reality star’s daughter, was just 16 years old at the time and served as co-host of the event alongside actor J. Eddie Peck, according to footage of the pageant.
source_fact_map.source_excerpt: SFGATE, by Kelsey Bradshaw, published October 13, 2016: “The 1997 Miss Teen USA beauty pageant, where contestants said Donald Trump walked in on naked teenagers in the dressing room, was held on South Padre Island in Texas. The pageant, now almost 10 years ago, was the first under Trump’s tenor after he bought Miss USA, Miss Teen USA and Miss Universe in 1996. Ivanka Trump, the reality star’s daughter, was just 16 years old at the time and served as co-host of the event alongside actor J. Eddie Peck, according to footage of the pageant.”
